home_meta_title: Amoria | Event décor, gifts, rentals and décor school in Addis Ababa
home_meta_description: Amoria in Mekanisa, Addis Ababa: wedding, birthday and event decoration, a gift shop, equipment rental and a décor school. Pay online with telebirr, CBE Birr or card.
home_lede: Event décor that turns a room into a memory, a shop of gifts worth giving, equipment to rent, and a school to learn the craft.
home_pay_note: Pay with telebirr, CBE Birr or card. Collect from the shop or have it delivered.
home_biz_heading: Four ways we make it special
home_biz_decor_body: Weddings, birthdays, engagements and more. Tell us the day and the feeling; we design it, quote it and set it up.
home_biz_gifts_body: Gifts worth giving, wrapped the way they should be. Pay online, then collect in Mekanisa or have it delivered.
home_biz_rentals_body: Stands, linen, lighting and more for your own event. Pick your dates and see the price straight away.
home_biz_school_body: Learn the craft of event décor, one intake at a time. See the dates and how many seats are left.
home_step_1_body: The date, the place, the guests and the mood. It takes two minutes, no account needed.
home_step_2_body: Our team builds a clear, itemised quote for your event and sends it to you.
home_step_3_body: Accept the quote, pay the deposit online, and we take it from there.
home_gallery_body: The kind of rooms we love to dress: draped halls, long tables, garden receptions and aisles lined with flowers.
home_school_body: Event décor is a skill you can learn. Choose a course, see the next start date and how many seats are left, and register when you are ready.
home_school_none: New dates are on the way. Message us and we will tell you first.
home_contact_body: Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram and we will reply with ideas and a price. Or come and see the shop in Mekanisa.
home_visit_heading: Come and see us in Mekanisa
home_visit_body: Drop in to see our gifts, décor and rental pieces in person, and talk your event through with the team.

about_meta_title: About Amoria | Décor, gifts and rentals in Mekanisa
about_meta_description: Meet Amoria: a house of event décor, gifts, equipment rental and a décor school in Mekanisa, Addis Ababa.
about_lede: Amoria is where Addis Ababa comes to decorate, give and gather: event décor, gifts, rentals and a school, together in Mekanisa.
about_story_quote: Every celebration starts with a feeling.
about_story_1: The hush before a bride walks in. A child’s face at a birthday table. A gift that says what words cannot. Amoria exists to give those moments a beautiful place to happen.
about_story_2: So we work on every side of it. We decorate the room, we sell the gift, we rent the pieces you need for your own event, and we teach the craft to anyone who wants to learn it.
about_story_3: Whatever brings you to us, you should know what it costs, what happens next, and who to ask. That is the whole idea.
about_value_1_body: Décor comes as an itemised quote you can read line by line. Gifts and rentals show their price before you pay.
about_value_2_body: Pay with telebirr, CBE Birr or card, or by bank transfer. You never need an account.
about_value_3_body: Everything here is in English and Amharic, so you can read it and reply the way you prefer.
about_cta_heading: Let us make your day beautiful
